title: 透明筐体の卓上ポップコーン機
description: 売店や映画館のカウンターに配置するポップコーン機。四隅の支柱と天蓋、実際に透過する側面/前面/閉じた後扉、内側の吊り下げ釜と軸・ブラケット・半蓋、底の受け面、引出し取手、後扉の蝶番/握り、裏面電源口を一式に造形しています。GLBのガラスは淡いアルファ透過で屈折表現ではありません。ポップコーン、発光、加熱/撹拌/扉動作は付属しません。台の高さに合わせて配置する静的小物で、食品機器としての機能や適合を示しません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.680 × 0.995 × 0.581 m、9,708三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A popcorn machine for concession or cinema counters. It includes corner posts/canopy, genuinely transparent side/front panes and closed rear doors, a suspended kettle with shaft, brackets and half lid, collection floor, drawer pull, rear hinges/handles and power inlet. GLB glazing uses light alpha blending rather than refraction. No popcorn, illumination, heating/stirring or door motion is included. Adjust placement to counter height; this static prop is not a functioning or certified food appliance. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.680 × 0.995 × 0.581 m; 9,708 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
